scope: Separate bounded HTML/Markdown conversion through actual paired native clipboard admission and existing guarded document/grid actions. The Office snippets are representative markup patterns, not captured application-native clipboard certification.

contract.imageMapping: Explicit synchronous registry lookup for host-owned immutable bytes; separate safe portable export URL policy
contract.notices: Closed aggregated codes/counts, with loss versus compatibility effects; no source text/URLs/CSS/asset identifiers
contract.markdown: CommonMark parsing plus tables, strikethrough, parsed tasks and sanitized raw HTML; no automatic linkification or typography; not full GFM
contract.html: Inert complete-document parsing, closed semantic conversion, simple stylesheet selector cascade and individually recognized bounded CSS values

artifacts.adapterDigestAlgorithm: SHA256 of sorted .js/.d.ts basenames, each followed by NUL, its exact bytes and NUL

verification.sourceTypecheck: Strict existing base configuration, no skipped library checking and no emission on error
verification.testSourceTypecheck: Strict test-source checking with test-only skipLibCheck for existing Vite/Vitest declaration conflicts; dependency declaration cleanliness is not claimed
verification.foreignRoundTripExclusions: Conversion-owned source identities and merge causal/context identities, represented by exact relative geometry instead; text, format literals, headers, widths, asset references, captions and independent source-cell bodies remain compared
verification.localSharedAstComparisonExclusions: Only newly authored merge lamport/writer/counter priority words
verification.offlineRecovery: Both authors restored after import/reconnect; future selective Undo/Redo compares whole checkpoint bytes under identical actual admitted remote frame inputs

repairedDuringImplementation: Converter property maps did not initially satisfy the existing ascending-key native record grammar; fixed the adapter, not Rust admission
Nested Markdown tasks were indented as code blocks; continuation indentation now follows the actual list marker width
Exported task checkbox metadata could manufacture an empty item head; noncontent staging no longer creates an extra paragraph
Full-document body styles needed document parsing rather than dropped fragment-wrapper attributes
Covered merge cells require versioned complete relative partition wrappers to retain their independent bodies and headers
explicitLimits: 1 MiB source and final output; bounded HTML construction/repair/depth and Markdown token creation, plus unchanged native limits
Simple tag/class/ID stylesheet selectors only; unsupported selectors, at-rules, styles and metadata have notices
Host-resolved images only; missing mappings retain available alt/caption text with a notice
Nested tables and hidden table axes/cells or list entries reject instead of shifting geometry or exposing hidden content
Basic Markdown cannot preserve every native feature; declared safe HTML fallback is a compatibility notice
No complete arbitrary HTML/CSS, full GFM, Office binary file format, spreadsheet formula, or native clipboard certification claim
remaining: Opt-in browser HTML/Markdown clipboard routing with unchanged private-MIME priority and defaults
Visible post-commit conversion/destination notices and managed SDK/React plus asset-registry wiring
Deferred broad browser, native IME/accessibility, performance and release qualification
